_comment: Authored, purpose-implying prop clusters (bible sec2 P3: do not dump props everywhere). Structures from the Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md), placed by scripts/world/props.gd: each entry is stood on the ground by asking the world (D09), given a box collider from its combined mesh AABB, and scaled by its own `scale` -- the pack is authored close to real-world size so most entries sit near 1.0. ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_layout: work_area sits south-west of the village square's workshop [2,2] (EV6: the Medieval Village workshop stands where the old farm-pack Barn stood, its open arch bay facing this cluster so the nook reads as the workshop's own yard) -- a smithing/repair nook implying someone maintains the settlement's tools, far enough from the workshop's footprint and the Quarry Foreman NPC [0,-6] to read as its own spot rather than clutter. farmhouse_yard sits south of Grandpa's house [-22,-16] -- storage and harvest overflow for a farm that feeds itself. Grandpa's house is a real footprint, not just its terrain pad (grandpa_house.gd: INNER_W 9.0/INNER_D 7.0/WALL_T 0.3 -> half_w 4.8, half_d 3.8, so the house's own south wall sits at z=-19.8) -- an earlier placement here landed props inside that wall; kept 4m+ clear of it now, and still off the house's east-facing door lane (tested by smoke_opening, x -16..-9.7 at z~-15).
_comment_layout_ev7r: EV7-remainder: the two of the bible's remaining three named clusters that had real geography to sit on. trainer_camp sits inside the practice-meadow clearing (vegetation.json, [30,-40] r16) but off route 2's path (terrain_playground.json, [18,-24]->[30,-40]) near [26,-28] -- a waypoint on the way to the arena, not inside it. bridge_repair_site sits on the footbridge's own west bank (village.json's footbridge, EV6-remainder, [-136.3,113] yaw -5) near [-141.7,114] -- see _comment_layout_ev7fix below for the current exact siting of both, which moved from EV7-remainder's own first numbers. quarry_station is NOT built here -- no quarry exists anywhere in the world (village_npcs.json's Quarry Foreman still stands in the square for exactly that reason) and building one is out of scope for a prop-placement item; left open, same as EV6-remainder left it.
_comment_layout_ev7fix: EV7-clusters-fix: a placement-only round after a genuine blind critic read the shipped state and failed trainer_camp outright ('reads as three container props at even spacing... scatter-list output, not a place') while passing bridge_repair_site's purpose but naming real composition defects (EV7-remainder-critique's own DONE.md entry had self-graded both as passing without ever running a real blind pass -- that self-grade is overturned here, honestly, not quietly dropped). trainer_camp drops `Bench` (a trestle table nothing was ever resting ON, since props.gd places every prop flush to the ground with no way to stack one on another -- the crate/sack/barrel all passed clean through its legs) and re-spaces the remaining three with real, uneven gaps. bridge_repair_site's whole cluster moves ~3m to hug the footbridge's actual west landing (tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd, bridge local frame) instead of sitting in open lawn off to the side of it, the axe gets a genuine lean via props.gd's new `pitch_deg`, and the rope moves to the crate's bridge-facing side instead of being tucked behind it. All positions in this pass were checked against real Terrain3D height data and the actual placed footbridge/mill transforms via tools/_probe_ev7fix.gd, not hand-estimated.
_comment_bands: BAND-SPLIT. The clusters array that used to live here is now cut per corridor band, under data/config/bands/<band>/props.json, and merged back at load by scripts/data/band_content.gd. What stays here is what is NOT positional and must not be duplicated five times where it could drift. Every entry carries an `order`; the merge sorts by it, so the merged array is byte-identical to the pre-split file (tests/test_band_content.gd pins that against tests/fixtures/band_split_baseline/).
_comment_ow5d: OW5D: bridge_repair_site and quarry_station relocated by the same deltas as the mill footbridge and Old Quarry they dress (docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2), so they do not strand at the structures old, now-empty coordinates. work_area, farmhouse_yard and trainer_camp are unmoved village/practice-meadow clusters (section 10.1, unmoved by design).
